reader.requirement: At --std 85, every file description entry of the run unit associated with one external indexed file connector must give the RECORD KEY data-name-1 the same data description entry at the same relative location in the record; a run unit whose entries differ is not conforming source, which the compiler may refuse.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002 runs CheckFileDescriptions where later editions run CheckFormat; the KEY segment comparison is edition-free
the citation text of COBOL6847 only

reader.edition-search: read FileEntryIdentity (no edition reference: grep Edition/DialectLevel finds none) and ExternalFileConnectorRules.Check; KeyEntry renders name, byte offset in the record (RecordLayout.OffsetOf), group/elementary shape, width and the ActivationDescriptions category/clauses.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the KEY segment is the same at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the cited witness is a RELATIVE file with no RECORD KEY; no witness is an indexed file whose prime key differs in description or location

probes.expected: the same key description at the same offset compiles; B reads by the key A wrote

probes.printed: error COBOL6847: ... differ in the RECORD KEY clause
probes.expected: IX-KEY PIC X(4) at offset 0 against offset 1 violates GR4

probes.printed: error COBOL6847: ... differ in the RECORD KEY clause
probes.expected: an elementary PIC X(4) key against a group key of two X(2) is a different data description entry; refused

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.2.7.4 GR4  (2.7.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR4
OK  §1985:IX.2.3.4 GR1  (2.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: The RECORD KEY description and location are one segment of the shared external-entry identity, compared across the compilation group (COBOL6847) and registered for the run time. The diagnostic cites IX.2.3.4 GR1 f (the file control entry's form of the same requirement) rather than IX.2.7.4 GR4; both name the same condition.

refuter.evidence: Read FileEntryIdentity.KeyEntry (name, RecordLayout offset, G/E and width, ActivationDescriptions category/clauses/positions). Over-rejection attack at --std 85, sibling programs on one EXTERNAL indexed file: PIC XXXX vs X(4) (k_picform), explicit USAGE DISPLAY (k_usage), RECORD KEY IX-KEY OF IX-REC vs IX-KEY (k_qual), a different record-name (k_recname), level 03 vs 05 (k_level), the key in a second 01 record of the FD (k_secondrec) all compile and B reads 'B K001HELLO1' (exit 0). JUSTIFIED RIGHT on one key only (k_justified) refused COBOL6847 'differ in the RECORD KEY clause': a different data description entry. A group key whose subordinates split differently (2+2 vs 1+3, k_groupsub) is accepted: the group's own entry is the same and the rule has no detection half, so not an overturn. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:IX.2.7.4 GR4  (2.7.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR4'.
